activities.activity_description: Develop a Kinesis sink module for s-c-s, including AWS SDK integration, configuration, and testing.
Adapt the Log module from XD to s-c-s, ensuring compatibility with Spring Cloud Stream.
Design and implement a job DSL for orchestrating workflows, integrating with Spring Cloud Data Flow.
Port the field-value-counter module from XD to s-c-s, adapting to the new framework.
Port the aggregate-counter module from XD to s-c-s, ensuring functionality and tests.
Port the gauge module from XD to s-c-s, adapting to Spring Cloud Stream's architecture.
Port the rich-gauge module from XD to s-c-s, including UI and data handling components.
Develop a Flink processor module for s-c-s, integrating with Apache Flink's streaming APIs.
